summary: Chelan County, WA summit 14 miles west of Chelan; register and firelookout.com give a 1931 L-4 cab, now gone, but a visit found no trace of one.

facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the L-4 cab is gone; no removal year is given, and a visit found no trace of a cab.

events.note: L-4 cab reported as built; not confirmed, a visit found no trace of one (cite 3)
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register

evidence.supports: register: L-4 cab built 1931 and now gone
evidence.quote: Built in 1931, this L-4 cab is now gone.

evidence.supports: site is about 14 miles west of Chelan
register places the site in the Wenatchee National Forest
Forest Lookouts names the Chelan National Forest
a 1931 L-4 cab is reported for Baldy
evidence.quote: Baldy was said to have an L-4 cab in 1931

evidence.supports: Willhite thinks a camp may have been on the summit
evidence.quote: it seems likely a camp may have been on the summit

evidence.supports: flat area with old cut stumps, fire rings and cans suggesting camping
evidence.quote: obvious signs of camping exist with many old sun bleached cut stumps, fire rings and old cans scattered about

evidence.supports: no nails, concrete, boards or anchors found on the summit
evidence.quote: I saw no nails, concrete, wood boards, anchors, glass, etc.

evidence.supports: route up the Entiat Valley Road past Ardenvoir, then FR 5380 and FR 8410
evidence.quote: Take the Entiat Valley Road past Ardenvoir to FR5380, then up FR8410.
High clearance is probably best with decent tires.

evidence.supports: elevation gain 1,000 feet and a short scramble to the rocky top
evidence.quote: A short scramble gets you to the rocky top

evidence.supports: FFLA lists the Baldy Mountain site as a Ground site with status Gone
evidence.quote: Baldy Mountain Chelan 47.86364 -120.32911 Ground Gone FFLOS US 1384, WA 284

corrections.why: The FFLA Chelan County listing gives 47.86364, -120.32911, which fits firelookout.com's '14 miles west of Chelan'. The record's point is about 55 km (34 miles) from Chelan.

notes_for_editor: The 1931 L-4 cab is unconfirmed: the register and firelookout.com repeat the same claim, while Willhite's visit found no trace and suggests a camp. Kind left as the record's 'unknown' for the editor; FFLA's Type column says Ground, and a camp would fall under no-structure kinds. Agency conflict: register says Wenatchee National Forest, Forest Lookouts says Chelan National Forest; not resolved. The record's point is about 55 km from Chelan and the FFLA point fits the '14 miles west' text, so the location correction is proposed for review. The existing record us-wa-baldy-mountain has a research file with the same register and firelookout sources, so the two IDs may describe one site.
